article.headline: Who Are the UK's NEETs? Why More Young People Are Now Out of Work, Education and Training

plan.title: UK NEETs: What It Means for Students
plan.hook: Nearly 1 Million UK Youth Not Working
plan.voiceover: The International Business Times UK reports that nearly one million young people aged 16 to 24 in the UK are neither working, studying, nor training. That's about one in eight young people — a big deal if you're juggling rent and exams. The government plans new reforms in welfare and apprenticeships to tackle this, but changes may take years. Keep an eye on how this might affect job opportunities near you in the coming months.

plan.post_caption: Almost a million young Brits are currently not in education, employment, or training. The government is considering big reforms, but results may be slow. Stay informed and prepare for shifts in job and apprenticeship availability this year. Source: International Business Times UK.
